cases.name: Kameryn Recchia
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Our beautiful, precious, smiling Kameryn “Kam”, “Kami”, “Kiki” will always be the firecracker of our family. Her sense of humor, quirkiness and humorous facial expressions brightened our lives. From the moment Kameryn was born her inner joy and spunkiness shined. Everyone loved her instantaneously! Kam’s beautiful, piercing green eyes, her infectious laughter and smile would light up your soul. She was an intelligent, caring, outgoing, kind and gentle soul, who loved spending time with her family and friends. Kameryn independently raised her three-year old son Wyatt, who was the center of her world. He is just as precious, kind, loving and as beautiful as his mom."
cases.narrative: On 10/10/2022, her stepfather entered through a window of her double-wide home, unlocked the door for police and officers found her body in the kitchen during a welfare check. She had been shot twice in the head.
